commands.command: TBD: combine M103 outcome snippets with a broad M102/M98 action-retention or hidden-envelope-retention guard before another actor-coupling optimization
commands.name: m105_retention_constrained_outcome_coupling

decision_rule: Admit only if the optimized checkpoint preserves M98/M102 braking and lateral hidden-envelope lift while producing reset or zero-response behavior degradation on outcome-sensitive gates without normal-behavior regression.
failure_criteria: outcome loss improves but reset-hidden behavior does not degrade
braking or lateral hidden-envelope lift is negative versus reset hidden
normal behavior regresses versus M62 or M98
the objective introduces hidden physics or oracle labels into actor inputs
hypothesis: M103 failed because fitting reset-sensitive snippets alone changed the closed-loop trajectory distribution enough to lose hidden-envelope retention. A broad retention-constrained outcome objective may keep M102's hidden belief while recovering M101-style behavior dependence.
success_criteria: uses only deployable actor observations and training-time outcome labels
preserves M62/M98 normal behavior and clearance margin
reset or zero-response ablations degrade success or clearance
retains positive braking and lateral response-hidden-minus-reset envelope lift
records objective repeats and full behavior and hidden-envelope gates
